items.title: Dogs Can Sniff-Out Invasive Plant Species With High Accuracy to Curb Their Destruction
items.summary: Sniffer dogs are being trained in Germany to detect potentially destructive invasive plants—alien species that are one of the main causes of biodiversity loss worldwide.

items.title: Lucky Bird Found in Storm Drain a Mile From Home After Passing Driver Happens to Spot it Hopping in
items.summary: A pet budgie that vanished when a storm blew open a kitchen window was found hiding in a storm drain a mile from home.
